body: Founder, real-time: 'add little musical sound effects to redgarden to add legibility via midi.' Real scope decision: raw SDL2 core audio, no SDL2_mixer dependency, avoiding both open questions the backlog item flagged (new mixer dep, second DLL to bundle). Short low thud on hit landing, ascending A4/C#5/E5 triad per ability slot on cast (mirrors S170-124's color tiers in sound), gated to a ~15-unit hearing radius around the local player to avoid noise in a real 20-hero match. Graceful no-op if no audio device available. Client-only change. Verified: clean build, full suite (277 checks), VS0/VS1 stable. Commit 68c00a4.
title: Small musical sound effects for gameplay legibility (S170-92)
